question: How many members were there in the Constituent Assembly on 31st December 1947?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**299**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **31st December 1947**, the **Constituent Assembly of India** had a total of **299 members.**
 
• The **Constituent Assembly** was established to draft the **Constitution of India**, which came into effect on **26th January 1950.**
 
• The assembly originally had **389 members**, but after the partition of India in 1947, the number reduced to **299 members.**
 
• Out of the 299 members, **229 represented British India**, and **70 represented the princely states.**
 
• The assembly was chaired by **Dr. Rajendra Prasad**, who later became the first **President of India.**
 
• The work of the Constituent Assembly was divided into several committees, such as the **Drafting Committee**, chaired by **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**, which was responsible for preparing the draft of the Constitution.
 
• The assembly met for a total of **165 days** spread over **2 years, 11 months, and 18 days** to deliberate on the provisions of the Constitution.
 
• The Constituent Assembly played a vital role in shaping the legal and institutional framework of India, incorporating values of **justice, equality, liberty, and fraternity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Historical Contributions of the Assembly:**__

 
 
• The assembly drafted and adopted the **Indian Constitution**, which is one of the largest written constitutions in the world.
 
• It incorporated important principles like **Fundamental Rights**, **Directive Principles of State Policy**, and provisions for a **federal structure.**
 
• Prominent leaders such as **Jawaharlal Nehru, Sardar Patel, Maulana Azad, and B.R. Ambedkar** contributed significantly to the debates and discussions.
